name: Imelda Mutio
signOff: Good conversations. Great audiences. Real impact.
defaultDescription: Imelda Mutio is a Nairobi MC, event host and voice-over artist. She presents the Mid-Morning Show on Classic 105 and brings the warmth of live radio to events, brand campaigns, ads and voice-overs.

steps.label: The intern
steps.text: I walked into Classic 105 as an intern, learning from some of the biggest voices in Kenyan radio.

steps.label: The midnight show
steps.text: Hard work and a lot of determination earned me my own slot: the midnight show, keeping listeners company long after everyone else had signed off.

steps.label: Daytime
steps.text: Before long I moved to daytime. Today I host the Mid-Morning Show, weekdays from 10am to 3pm, straight after Maina and King'ang'i's morning show.

steps.label: Beyond the studio
steps.text: Off air, I bring that same voice to your brand and your stage: voice-overs, ads, hosting and MC work.
